competency_question: What are all the hurricane-specific hazard attributes available that are related to a geographical place, and all the damage impact details available and their temporal data if available?
sparql_query:
PREFIX kwglr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-resource/>
PREFIX kwgl-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-ontology/>
SELECT ?place
       ?attributeName
       ?damageProperty
       ?tempProperty
       ?tempYear
WHERE {
  ?hazard a kwgl-ont:HazardEvent ;
          kwgl-ont:hasHazardType kwglr:hurricane .  # hurricane-specific hazard

  ?hazard kwgl-ont:hasImpacted ?place .            # related to a geographical place
  
  OPTIONAL {
    ?place ?damageProperty ?damageValue .
    FILTER (regex(STR(?damageProperty), "dollarDamageOfHurricanes"))
    BIND (strafter(str(?damageProperty), "dollarDamageOfHurricanesImpactingPlace") AS ?suffix)
    BIND ("dollarDamageOfHurricanesImpactingPlace" AS ?baseProp)
    
    # If the property has a year suffix, extract it
    OPTIONAL {
      BIND (REPLACE(STR(?damageProperty), ^.*dollarDamageOfHurricanesImpactingPlace([0-9]{4})$ , "$1") AS ?tempYear)
    }
  }
  
  OPTIONAL {
    ?place ?tempProperty ?tempValue .
    
    # temperature related properties
    FILTER regex(STR(?tempProperty),
                 "(average|minimum|maximum)MonthlyTemperatureInCelsius[0-9]{4}$|"
                 "(averageHeating|averageCooling)DegreeDaysPerMonth[0-9]{4}$")
    
    BIND (strafter(str(?tempProperty), "dollarDamageOfHurricanesImpactingPlace") AS ?suffix)
    BIND ("dollarDamageOfHurricanesImpactingPlace" AS ?baseProp)
    
    # Extract year from property name if present
    OPTIONAL {
      BIND (REPLACE(STR(?tempProperty),
                    "(average|minimum|maximum)MonthlyTemperatureInCelsius([0-9]{4})$|"
                    "(averageHeating|averageCooling)DegreeDaysPerMonth([0-9]{4})$", "$2")
            AS ?tempYear)
    }
  }
  
  BIND (STR(?damageProperty) AS ?attributeName)
}
ORDER BY ?place

competency_question: What are all the available storm-specific hazard attributes and their details related to all geographical places?
sparql_query:
PREFIX kwglr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-resource/>
PREFIX kwgl-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-ontology/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?place
       ?hazardAttribute
       ?attributeValue
WHERE {
  ?event a kwgl-ont:HazardEvent ;
        kwgl-ont:hasHazardType ?hazardType .
  
  FILTER(?hazardType IN (
         kwglr:hurricane,
         kwglr:tropicalStorm,
         kwglr:tropicalDepression,
         kwglr:stormSurgeTide ))
         
  ?event kwgl-ont:impactedBy ?event .
  ?event kwgl-ont:hasImpacted ?place .
  
  # Storm‑specific attributes that are defined on Places
  OPTIONAL { ?place kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfHurricanesImpactingPlace        ?v1          } BIND(?v1 AS ?attributeValue)
  OPTIONAL { ?place kwgl-ont:numberOfHurricanesImpactingPlace             ?v2          } BIND(?v2 AS ?attributeValue)
  OPTIONAL { ?place kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfTornadoesImpactingPlace        ?v3          } BIND(?v3 AS ?attributeValue)
  OPTIONAL { ?place kwgl-ont:numberOfTornadoesImpactingPlace              ?v4          } BIND(?v4 AS ?attributeValue)
  OPTIONAL { ?place kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfStormSurgesImpactingPlace      ?v5          } BIND(?v5 AS ?attributeValue)
  OPTIONAL { ?place kwgl-ont:numberOfStormSurgesImpactingPlace            ?v6          } BIND(?v6 AS ?attributeValue)
  
  # Bind the attribute URI based on which optional clause matched
  VALUES ?hazardAttribute {
    kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfHurricanesImpactingPlace        (BIND(?v1 AS ?attributeValue))
    kwgl-ont:numberOfHurricanesImpactingPlace              (BIND(?v2 AS ?attributeValue))
    kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfTornadoesImpactingPlace         (BIND(?v3 AS ?attributeValue))
    kwgl-ont:numberOfTornadoesImpactingPlace               (BIND(?v4 AS ?attributeValue))
    kwgl-ont:dollarDamageOfStormSurgesImpactingPlace       (BIND(?v5 AS ?attributeValue))
    kwgl-ont:numberOfStormSurgesImpactingPlace             (BIND(?v6 AS ?attributeValue))
  }
}

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

       ?damageCrops 
       ?damageInfrastructure

  ?hazardEvent a kwgl-ont:Tornado ;

  ?hazardEvent kwgl-ont:hasStartDate ?startDate .
  ?hazardEvent kwgl-ont:hasEndDate   ?endDate .
  FILTER(?startDate >= "2020-01-01"^^xsd:date && ?endDate <= "2022-12-31"^^xsd:date)

  # Damage details
  OPTIONAL { ?hazardEvent kwgl-ont:damageToCropsInDollars      ?damageCrops . }
  OPTIONAL { ?hazardEvent kwgl-ont:damageToInfrastructureInDollars ?damageInfrastructure . }

  # Relation to a geographical place

  ?place a kwgl-ont:Place .

competency_question: What are all the damage details available done by storm-specific hazards that are related to a geographical place within a certain temporal extent?
sparql_query:
PREFIX kwglr: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-resource/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX kwgl-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/lite-ontology/>
SELECT ?event ?place ?cropDamage ?infraDamage ?deathCount
WHERE {
  ?event a kwgl-ont:HazardEvent ;
         kwgl-ont:hasHazardType ?hazardType .
  
  FILTER (?hazardType IN (
    kwglr:blizzard,
    kwglr:hurricane,
    kwglr:tornado,
    kwglr:thunderstormWind,
    kwglr:strongWind,
    kwglr:denseFog,
    kwglr:denseSmoke,
    kwglr:flashFlood,
    kwglr:flood,
    kwglr:highSurf,
    kwglr:coastalFlood,
    kwglr:lakeshoreFlood,
    kwglr:stormSurgeTide
  ))
  
  ?event kwgl-ont:damageToCropsInDollars ?cropDamage ;
         kwgl-ont:damageToInfrastructureInDollars ?infraDamage ;
         kwgl-ont:numberOfDeaths ?deathCount .
         
  OPTIONAL { ?event kwgl-ont:hasStartDate ?startDate . }
  OPTIONAL { ?event kwgl-ont:hasEndDate   ?endDate   . }
  
  FILTER (bound(?startDate) && bound(?endDate))
  FILTER (?startDate >= "2023-01-01"^^xsd:date)
  FILTER (?endDate   <= "2023-12-31"^^xsd:date)

  ?event kwgl-ont:hasImpacted ?place .
  ?place a kwgl-ont:Place .
}

sparql_query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX kwg-ont: <http://stko-kwg.geog.ucsb.edu/lod/ontology/>
PREFIX time: <http://www.w3.org/2006/time#>
PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>

SELECT ?damageProperty ?damageCrop ?deathDirect ?deathIndirect ?injuryDirect ?injuryIndirect
WHERE {
  ?hazard kwg-ont:hasTemporalScope ?temporalExtent ;
          a kwg-ont:NOAATornado .

  ?impact kwg-ont:affectedBy ?hazard ;
          a kwg-ont:ImpactObservationCollection .

  ?impact kwg-ont:impactObservablePropertyDamageProperty ?damageProperty .
  ?impact kwg-ont:impactObservablePropertyDamageCrop ?damageCrop .
  ?impact kwg-ont:impactObservablePropertyDeathDirect ?deathDirect .
  ?impact kwg-ont:impactObservablePropertyDeathIndirect ?deathIndirect .
  ?impact kwg-ont:impactObservablePropertyInjuryDirect ?injuryDirect .
  ?impact kwg-ont:impactObservablePropertyInjuryIndirect ?injuryIndirect .

  # Ensure the hazard is related to a geographical place
  ?hazard geo:hasGeometry ?geometry ;
          kwg-ont:sfWithin ?place .  

  # Temporal extent filter (example using xsd:dateTime, adjust as needed)
  FILTER(?temporalExtent >= "2023-01-01T00:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime && 
         ?temporalExtent <= "2024-12-31T23:59:59"^^xsd:dateTime)
}
